fixturePolicy.opaque: Both comparators count the same single perceptually material colour delta.
fixturePolicy.scene-gradient: Both comparators retain the twelve-byte smooth gradient shift below threshold.
fixturePolicy.text-edge: Both comparators count two boundary pixels and mark one interior coverage pixel as antialiasing.
fixturePolicy.transparent: Both comparators count the same visible black coverage change, retain the coloured opacity delta below threshold, and ignore fully transparent RGB-only change.
